title: Project Procurement Manager
description:
Job Description – Project Procurement Manager

Company \- Satvik Enterprises Limited

**Project Procurement Manager**

Department

Procurement \& Supply Chain

Reporting To

Head – Procurement / Project Director

Location

Corporate Office / Project Site

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced **Project Procurement Manager** to lead the procurement activities for large\-scale industrial projects. The ideal candidate must have successfully handled **a minimum of two complete plant setup projects** from concept to commissioning, with expertise in sourcing project equipment, managing vendor contracts, expediting deliveries, and coordinating with engineering and project teams.

Experience in **Ferro Alloy, Steel, Power, Cement, Mining, or other heavy industrial projects** will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end\-to\-end procurement activities for new plant/project execution.
* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with project schedules and budgets.
* Source and procure capital equipment, machinery, structural materials, electrical and mechanical packages, and project consumables.
* Prepare RFQs, evaluate techno\-commercial bids, negotiate pricing, and finalize purchase orders.
* Coordinate closely with Engineering, Projects, QA/QC, Finance, and Site Execution teams.
* Identify and develop reliable domestic and international vendors.
* Monitor manufacturing progress, inspections, dispatch, logistics, and timely delivery of project materials.
* Ensure procurement milestones are achieved in line with project timelines.
* Review technical specifications, BOQs, drawings, and procurement schedules.
* Manage vendor performance, contract administration, and dispute resolution.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, quality standards, and statutory requirements.
* Prepare procurement reports, MIS, cost\-saving initiatives, and project procurement dashboards.
* **Good knowledge about Compliance.**

Eligibility Criteria Educational Qualification

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Metallurgical, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain or Materials Management will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **10–15\+ years** of experience in project procurement.
* **Mandatory experience of handling at least two complete industrial plant setup projects** from procurement planning to commissioning.
* Experience in **Ferro Alloy Plant Projects** will be highly preferred.
* Strong exposure to procurement of:
* Mechanical Equipment
* Electrical Systems
* Structural Steel
* Piping \& Utilities
* Refractories
* Material Handling Systems
* EPC Packages
* Imported Equipment

Required Skills

* Project Procurement Planning
* Strategic Sourcing \& Vendor Development
* Contract Management
* Techno\-Commercial Negotiation
* Cost Optimization
* Project Scheduling \& Expediting
* Vendor Performance Management
* Supply Chain Coordination
* ERP/SAP Procurement Modules
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills

Mandatory Requirement

* Must have independently managed procurement for **a minimum of two complete industrial plant projects**.
* Proven experience in coordinating with EPC contractors, consultants, engineering teams, and project execution teams.
* Strong understanding of project procurement cycles, logistics, import procurement, and project documentation.

Preferred Industry

* Ferro Alloy
* Steel
* Power
* Cement
* Mining
* Heavy Engineering
* Metals \& Minerals

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹200,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
